normalized_text: On January 27, 1967, Apollo 1 astronauts Virgil Grissom, Edward White, and Roger Chaffee died in a flash fire during a ground test. The capsule was pressurized with pure oxygen at 16.7 psi. At 6:31 p.m., a flash fire broke out inside the cabin. NASA established an investigative board and later redesigned the Apollo spacecraft.
